experiences.dt: Waterline Marina, Holmes Beach (5325 Marina Drive).
experiences.pr: Public tour: $48 ages 7+; $42 children 6 and under, seniors 65+ and military. Private tour for up to 17 from $495 (covers six people; $50 each additional).
experiences.ag: All ages.
experiences.sm: Two-hour public and private dolphin tours from Waterline Marina in Holmes Beach around Anna Maria Island's back bay and toward the Gulf. The company also runs Egmont Key trips, sunset tours, sandbar trips, pontoon rentals and guided jet ski tours.
experiences.q: Depart from Waterline Marina in Holmes Beach for a 2-hour cruise around Anna Maria Island, with options for both private family charters and public group tours.

experiences.n: Fort De Soto E-Bike & Beach Day
experiences.dt: Fort De Soto Park (meeting point not stated on the tours page)
experiences.sm: A guided e-bike ride through Fort De Soto Park's trails, beaches, wildlife areas and the historic fort itself, with about 20 minutes of beach time to swim or relax.
experiences.q: Get ready to experience Fort De Soto by e-bike!

experiences.n: Downtown St. Pete Sights and Murals E-bike Tour
experiences.dt: Flora Wylie Park
experiences.ag: All ages, per the tour page; call about teen riders
experiences.sm: A 2.5-hour guided e-bike ride along downtown St. Petersburg's waterfront past murals, the Pier, the Dalí Museum and Albert Whitted Park, with a 20-minute coffee stop; e-bike and helmet included.
experiences.q: Explore Downtown St Petersburg's vibrant waterfront on this 2.5 hour E-bike tour.

experiences.pr: Starting at $15.99 (Animal Care Center tour; Animal Ambassador Insider Tour) up to $69.99 (Sloth, Giraffe, Rhino and Hippo encounters); most insider tours start at $29.99 or $39.99
experiences.ag: Varies by tour, from 3+ to 10+; guests under 14 with a responsible party (14+ or 18+, by tour)
experiences.sm: A menu of short behind-the-scenes add-ons with Busch Gardens animal care staff: insider tours with cheetahs, tigers, gorillas, chimpanzees, elephants, hippos, penguins and Australian animals, a sensory-friendly session, the Animal Care Center tour, and 30-45-minute sloth, giraffe, rhino and hippo encounters.

experiences.pr: Starting at $500.00 per person
experiences.ag: 3 and older; minimum 2 paying guests; under 18 with an adult
experiences.sm: A full-day guided Busch Gardens visit of up to seven hours with a private guide, priority access to rides and animal experiences.

experiences.pr: Starting at $249.99 per person; includes park admission
experiences.ag: 13 and older; under 18 with a paying adult (18+); up to 3 guests
experiences.sm: A four-hour morning (8:30 AM-12:30 PM) working alongside Busch Gardens animal care specialists, in Australia, Animal Ambassador or Elephant versions; park admission is included.

experiences.pr: Starting at $599.00 per party (up to 12 guests)
experiences.ag: 7 and older; under 14 with a paying adult (18+)
experiences.sm: A private 45-minute off-road safari for up to 12 guests, where you hand-feed an endangered black rhino and a giraffe with an animal care specialist.

experiences.dt: Animal Interactions & Tours in Nairobi
experiences.pr: Starting at $39.99 per person (varies by date, plus tax); park admission required and not included
experiences.ag: Ages 5 and older; under 14 with someone 14 or older
experiences.sm: An open-air truck ride across the park's 65-acre Serengeti Plain with a guide, where you hand-feed giraffes and see zebras, ostriches, rhinos and antelope. It is an add-on to park admission.
experiences.q: Trek across the 65-acre Serengeti Plain on an open-air touring vehicle

experiences.sc: Check-in by 5:15 pm
experiences.ss: Select nights from January to March
experiences.ag: 21 and older
experiences.sm: An evening package with a Serengeti Safari before sunset, a guided walk to Treetop Kitchen with animal encounters, and a three-course African-inspired dinner with one cocktail. Park admission is not required.
experiences.q: Experience the magic of the wild with Sunset on the Serengeti, an exclusive evening adventure at Busch Gardens Tampa.
experiences.sn: Offered on select nights from January to March, per the Busch Gardens page (checked Sep 27, 2026).

experiences.dt: Honeymoon Island Docks inside Honeymoon Island State Park; buy tickets at the ferry ticket office there (not sold online).
experiences.pr: Round trip: adults $20; children 6-12 $10; 5 and under free. Military discount for active duty and retired with ID.
experiences.sc: Every day except Thanksgiving and Christmas, weather permitting; departs hourly from 10am all year, with half-hour departures mid-February through Labor Day and on weekends; stays of up to 4 hours depending on ticket time.
experiences.sm: Two ferry boats carry you from Honeymoon Island to Caladesi Island State Park, whose three miles of beach can be reached only by boat. You can bring chairs, umbrellas and coolers you can carry; beach carts and wagons are not allowed.
experiences.q: With 3 Miles of pristine beaches accessible only by boat, Caladesi Island is an unspoiled paradise, and a magical place for swimming, sun-bathing, picnics, snorkeling, or shelling!

experiences.n: Calypso Tropical Cruises: Calypso Breeze (John's Pass)
experiences.dt: John's Pass Village & Boardwalk; ticket window by the entrance of the parking garage.
experiences.ad: 177 Boardwalk Pl E, Madeira Beach, FL 33708
experiences.pr: Evening: adults with buffet $52.90, children with buffet $32.90; cruise only $27.90 adults (13+), $20.95 children (3-12). Daytime buffet cruise from $42.90.
experiences.ag: All ages.
experiences.sm: Two-hour evening cruises and daytime cruises with captain's narration from the John's Pass Boardwalk over Madeira Beach waters, with a DJ in the evening and an optional tropical buffet (beer, wine, rum punch and soft drinks included with buffet tickets).
experiences.q: Hop aboard at the John's Pass Boardwalk for two hours of tropical fun on the water—a casual evening cruise where shorts and sandals are perfectly fine.

experiences.n: Calypso Tropical Cruises: Calypso Queen (Clearwater Beach)
experiences.dt: Clearwater Beach Marina, 25 Causeway Blvd.
experiences.du: Evening cruise 2 hours; daytime cruise 90 minutes
experiences.pr: Evening: adults with buffet $52.90, children with buffet $32.90; cruise only $27.95 adults (13+), $20.95 children (3-12). Daytime buffet cruise from $42.90.
experiences.ag: All ages.
experiences.sm: Two-hour evening cruises and 90-minute daytime cruises on Clearwater Harbor with a DJ in the evening, captain's narration by day and an optional tropical buffet; buffet tickets include beer, wine, rum punch and soft drinks.
experiences.q: Step aboard for two hours of tropical fun on the water—the kind of casual evening where you can show up in shorts, kick back, and let the vacation feeling take over.

experiences.dt: Canoe Outpost, 18001 US Hwy 301 S, Wimauma, on the Little Manatee River; buses carry you and the boat to or from the put-in or take-out.
experiences.du: Trip 1: about 6 miles, about 2 1/2 hours of paddling; Trip 2: about 3 miles, about 1 1/4 hours; Trip 3: 6 miles, about 3 1/2 hours; Trip 4: 10 miles, about 5 1/2 hours
experiences.pr: Per boat, shuttle, life jackets and paddles included: tandem canoe or kayak $55-$59 and single kayak or SUP $43-$50, depending on the trip. Half-day rentals from the Outpost (up to 4 hours): $33 canoe or double kayak, $27 single kayak.
experiences.sc: Trip 1 launches continuously 9:00-2:00 daily and Trip 2 9:00-3:00; Trips 3 and 4 start with a bus at 9:30 or 11:00.
experiences.ss: Open all year; tubing on the Trip 2 route when river levels allow (usually in the summer rainy season).
experiences.sm: Canoe, kayak and paddleboard rentals with shuttle buses for self-guided one-way paddles down the Little Manatee River, including a run through Little Manatee River State Park; guided trips to Cockroach Bay and tubing when the river is high.
experiences.q: Located in southern Hillsborough County, Florida, we are less than an hour from Tampa, St. Petersburg, Clearwater, Bradenton, and Sarasota.

experiences.dt: Clearwater Beach Municipal Marina, 25 Causeway Blvd.
experiences.pr: Daytime (10AM and 2PM) with tax: adults 21-64 $45, seniors 65+ $43, juniors 13-20 and children 3-12 $39, babies 0-2 $13. Evening (6PM): adults $49, others as daytime.
experiences.sc: Sep 23-Oct 31: 2PM and 6PM daily, plus 10AM Saturdays and Sundays. Nov 1-30: 2PM and 5PM daily, plus 10AM Saturdays and Sundays; Thanksgiving one cruise at 1PM.
experiences.sm: A two-hour pirate-ship cruise from Clearwater Beach with water-gun battles, a treasure hunt, face painting and a dance party for children, and free beer and wine for adults 21 and over.
experiences.q: All cruises include tons of kids entertainment including water gun battles, treasure hunt, pirate stories, pirate face painting, dance party, kids honorary pirate certificates and so much more!

experiences.n: A Century of Baseball History Trolley Tour
experiences.dt: St. Petersburg (departure point not stated on the event page)
experiences.sc: Next listed: Saturday, Oct 10, 2026, 9:00-11:00 am
experiences.sm: A 2-hour trolley tour, curated by the Society for American Baseball Research, of the training fields and facilities used from 1914 to 1960 and the teams and players that made St. Petersburg an original spring training destination.
experiences.q: From Babe Ruth and Joe DiMaggio to Jackie Robinson and Stan Musial travel in Hall of Fame footsteps and discover over a century of baseball history in the Sunshine City.

experiences.dt: Clearwater Beach Marina, 25 Causeway Blvd; you board from the dock (Visit St. Pete/Clearwater: near the Marina Cantina building).
experiences.pr: $89.00 plus tax per flyer; observers $40.00; photo and video packs $40.00. Early-bird special for the first boat of the day $79.00 (book 24 hours ahead).
experiences.ag: Minimum age 5; under 18 need a parent or guardian to sign the waiver; no one over 265 lbs; two or three fly together depending on weight and wind.
experiences.sm: Parasail flights from a winch boat at the Clearwater Beach Marina: you take off from and land on the boat's flight deck, up to three at a time, for about 10 minutes in the air.
experiences.q: With winch boat technology you can even fly up to 3 persons at a time.

experiences.dt: Outside the Starbucks at the Hyatt Place, downtown Tampa
experiences.pr: Starting at $109
experiences.sc: 5 p.m. Fri; 11:30 a.m. Sat and Sun
experiences.ag: 21 or older with ID, including non-drinker tickets
experiences.sm: A guided brewery tour with round-trip transport, behind-the-scenes access at 3 breweries, up to 12 beers and a paired meal; sample stops include Southern Brewing & Winery, Cigar City Brewing, BarrieHaus and Bastet Brewing.
experiences.q: The Taste of Tampa Brew Tour offers behind-the-scenes access to 3 breweries and four tastings for a total of 12 different beers alongside a deliciously paired meal at one of our partners or a local restaurant.

experiences.dt: Pickup at 198 Seminole St., Clearwater.
experiences.pr: Private tour for up to 6 guests: 2 hours $350; 4 hours $600; 6 hours $800.
experiences.sm: Private captained pontoon trips for up to six from Clearwater to Caladesi Island or Honeymoon Island for swimming, shelling and dolphin watching. You bring your own snacks and drinks; wakesurfing, wakeboarding and tubing trips are also offered.
experiences.q: Cruise to Caladesi Island or Honeymoon Island aboard a comfortable pontoon boat with a licensed captain guiding your experience.

experiences.dt: Three stops: Downtown Clearwater, Clearwater Beach Marina (near Pier 60) and Dunedin Marina.
experiences.sc: Currently operating Thursday-Sunday between Downtown Clearwater, Clearwater Beach and Dunedin.
experiences.sm: A water taxi linking downtown Clearwater, Clearwater Beach Marina and Dunedin Marina, run as a partner of the county transit agency PSTA so you can reach the beach without driving and parking. Reservations are recommended; walk-ons board if there is room.
experiences.q: Our route services Clearwater and Dunedin with stops at Downtown Clearwater, Clearwater Beach Marina (near Pier 60) and Dunedin Marina (near breweries, shops and restaurants).

experiences.pr: $19.95 (prices may vary by date); aquarium admission required and not included
experiences.sc: Daily at 12:15 PM
experiences.ag: Minimum age 5; under 13 with an adult
experiences.sm: A 45-minute guided walk through areas closed to general admission: a VIP view of the Dolphin Complex, the seawater systems, the open-air critical care facility where animals are rehabilitated, and the food prep area.
experiences.q: Immerse yourself into the heart of CMA’s mission of rescue, rehab and release and our inspiring animal success stories.

experiences.dt: Stone Dolphin Complex
experiences.sc: Daily, Monday-Sunday, 1:15 p.m.
experiences.ag: Minimum age 7
experiences.sm: A 15-minute poolside session with the aquarium's resident dolphins and their care team, with a 6x8 photo; choose a shared session (up to 3 participants) or a private one (1-5). Aquarium admission is required and not included.
experiences.q: You’ll step into the Stone Dolphin Complex for a 15-minute poolside experience, featuring up-close moments and insights from our animal care team about CMA’s resident dolphins.

experiences.dt: Clearwater Marine Aquarium.
experiences.pr: $25.95 per person; prices may vary by date.
experiences.ss: Seasonal (dates on the aquarium's booking system).
experiences.ag: All ages.
experiences.sm: A one-hour eco-boat cruise in Clearwater Bay run by the aquarium, with talk about the local dolphin population and a loop around a bird sanctuary island.
experiences.q: Explore Clearwater Bay during this 60-minute eco-boat cruise. Learn about members of our local dolphin population, travel around a bird sanctuary island, and view seasonal local wildlife.
experiences.sn: The aquarium's page lists this tour's days as 'Seasonal' (page updated Feb 18, 2025); book online to see dates and times.

experiences.dt: Stingray Beach
experiences.sc: Daily at 10:45 AM, 12:15 PM, 2:30 PM and 4:00 PM (and 9:30 AM on select extended-hours dates)
experiences.ag: All ages
experiences.sm: Feed fish to the aquarium's resident cownose stingrays at Stingray Beach and learn what to do if you meet a stingray in the wild. Aquarium admission is required and not included; a waiver is required.
experiences.q: Experience what it’s like to feed fish to some of our resident cownose stingrays.

experiences.dt: Clearwater Marine Aquarium.
experiences.pr: $34.95 per person; prices may vary by date.
experiences.sc: Daily; times vary seasonally.
experiences.sm: A 90-minute eco-boat cruise in the estuary around Clearwater where staff pull a net and show you the sea creatures from the grass beds, then stop at a shell island where you can wade and collect shells (weather permitting).
experiences.q: Be a part of citizen science, and observe data collection in action, as we perform a net pull and conduct a "show and tell" onboard of sea creatures found in the grass beds and sand flats of the bay.

experiences.dt: Lower mangrove habitat
experiences.pr: $89.95 individual; $179.95 pair (may vary by date); aquarium admission required and not included
experiences.ag: Minimum age 7; maximum weight 250 lbs
experiences.sm: A 30-minute session helping the animal care team guide and feed Thelma, the aquarium's resident nurse shark, from a moving platform in the mangrove habitat.
experiences.q: Come meet Thelma, our resident nurse shark, and all her friends in the lower mangrove habitat.

experiences.dt: St. Pete Pier, 300 Second Ave NE, on the pier behind Fresco's (location given on the operator's booking page).
experiences.du: St. Pete Pier Tiki Cruise 1 hour 30 minutes; private cruises 1.5 or 3 hours
experiences.ag: Ages 6+.
experiences.sm: Captained floating tiki-bar cruises around the St. Pete Pier and downtown St. Petersburg: book a seat on the 90-minute pier cruise or a private boat for up to six. Bring your own drinks and food; coolers, ice and a Bluetooth radio are provided.

experiences.dt: Crystal River Watersports, 2380 N Suncoast Blvd (US 19), behind the Days Inn.
experiences.ad: 2380 N Suncoast Blvd, Crystal River, FL 34428
experiences.sc: Deluxe and private manatee adventures depart twice daily at 7:30 AM and 11:30 AM; the seasonal VIP tour once daily at 7:30 AM.
experiences.ss: VIP semi-private manatee tour seasonal November 15 - March 31; scalloping July 1 - September 24.
experiences.sm: Dive shop and tour operator in Crystal River offering three-hour manatee snorkel tours (group, semi-private and private), scalloping trips in season, Rainbow River drift dives, sunset cruises and mermaid experiences.

experiences.dt: James Family Wing (public pop-up tours)
experiences.ad: One Dali Blvd, St. Petersburg, FL 33701
experiences.pr: Private tours for 1-30 guests: standard admission plus $100 per docent
experiences.sc: Public pop-up tours of the permanent collection at 10:30am, 11:30am, 12:30pm, 1:30pm, 2:30pm and 3:30pm, subject to volunteer availability; private tours need a week's notice
experiences.sm: Volunteer docents lead periodic pop-up tours of the museum's permanent collection of Salvador Dalí's work during the day; private one-hour tours for up to 30 guests, including themed and foreign-language tours, can be booked a week ahead.
experiences.q: For something unique, consider the popular “ProvocaTour” which delves into the more provocative subjects in Dalí’s works.

experiences.n: The Dinner Detective Murder Mystery Dinner Show
experiences.dt: Hilton Garden Inn Tampa Airport Westshore
experiences.sc: Select Saturdays, 6:00-9:00 PM: Oct 10 and 31, Nov 7 and 21, Dec 5, 12 and 19, 2026
experiences.ag: Geared to adults; teens may be allowed with adult supervision; no infants or young children
experiences.sm: An interactive murder mystery dinner show with a plated multi-course dinner, in which the actors are out of costume and seated among the guests, so any diner may become a suspect.
experiences.q: our professional cast is hidden in the audience, turning every guest into a potential suspect.

experiences.n: St. Petersburg Hot Glass Workshop (watch glassblowing)
experiences.op: Duncan McClellan Gallery and DMG School Project
experiences.ad: 2342 Emerson Ave S, St. Petersburg, FL 33712
experiences.sc: Gallery open Monday-Saturday 11-6pm, Sundays 12-4pm
experiences.sm: A 2,400-square-foot working hot glass studio at the Duncan McClellan Gallery where visitors can watch artists blow glass at no charge; the nonprofit DMG School Project also runs beginner and intermediate adult classes.
experiences.q: The international and local artists who use the DMG Workshop are some of the premier artists in the medium, and the public has a front row seat to the action, at no charge.

experiences.n: Dolphin Landings Anglers Dream Party Boat Fishing
experiences.dt: Dolphin Landings dock, 4737 Gulf Boulevard.
experiences.ad: 4737 Gulf Blvd, St. Pete Beach, FL 33706
experiences.pr: $83 adults; $38 children 4-12; 3 and under free. Crew cleans fish free; an 18-20% tip is customary.
experiences.sc: Monday-Saturday 8 AM-1 PM; reservations in advance.
experiences.sm: A five-hour public party-boat trip into the Gulf for bottom fishing; the fishing license, bait and tackle are included.

experiences.n: Dolphin Landings Dolphin Watch and Sunset Sails
experiences.dt: Dolphin Landings dock behind Dolphin Village Shopping Center, 4737 Gulf Boulevard (free parking).
experiences.ad: 4737 Gulf Blvd, St. Pete Beach, FL 33706
experiences.pr: Dolphin watch sail: $50 adults, $40 children 2-12, free under 2. Sunset sail: $55 per person (adults only on public sails; no one under 7).
experiences.sc: Dolphin watch Mon-Sat 9:30 AM, 12 noon and 2:15 PM; Sun 12 noon and 2:15 PM. Sunset sails daily, departing about one hour before sunset.
experiences.sm: Public sailboat trips from St. Pete Beach: a two-hour dolphin-watch sail several times a day and a nightly sunset sail. BYOB is allowed; soda, water and a cooler with ice are provided.

experiences.op: Boat Tours at John's Pass (Sunshine Scenic Tours)
experiences.dt: John's Pass Village, 140 Boardwalk Pl. W.
experiences.ad: 140 Boardwalk Pl W, Madeira Beach, FL 33708
experiences.sc: Daily at 12:00 PM, 2:00 PM and 4:00 PM; sunset eco-tour at 6:00pm.
experiences.sm: A narrated 90-minute dolphin cruise in Boca Ciega Bay; the crew identifies resident dolphins by name. Sightings are guaranteed on daily cruises (not the sunset cruise) or the next trip is free.
experiences.q: We have been shown how to identify the dolphins by name and provide all of our guests with the opportunity to page through our Fin Book—our version of Facebook for dolphins!

experiences.n: Dolphin Snorkeling Cruise to Egmont Key
experiences.dt: 4630 29th Ave S, Gulfport (the operator says to call for other dock locations).
experiences.pr: Adults $60; children 2-12 $45; 1 and under free; taxes included. Masks and snorkels supplied.
experiences.sc: 7 days a week; four boats go out twice a day; reservations required.
experiences.sm: A half-day boat trip that watches for dolphins riding the wake, then lands on Egmont Key to explore the lighthouse, fort ruins and beaches and snorkel in the shallows; the boat and its bathroom stay at the island.
experiences.q: Egmont Key snorkeling is particularly well suited for the novice, because the water is so frequently clear, calm, shallow, and full of life.
experiences.sn: On hold: a notice image posted on the operator's home page in September 2026 says its captain, Captain Frank, died recently and 'until we get back on board all cruises are on hold and deposits refunded'. No restart date is given.

experiences.dt: St. Petersburg Museum of History
experiences.du: 1 hour (about 5 miles), 2 hours (about 8 miles) or 2.5 hours (about 12 miles)
experiences.pr: 1-hour Scenic $60; 2-hour Historic $70 (includes museum admission); 2.5-hour Eco $85 (includes Sunken Gardens admission)
experiences.sc: By appointment
experiences.ag: Segway riders 11 and older
experiences.sm: Guided Segway tours of downtown St. Petersburg that start at the Museum of History; the longer tours bundle admission to the museum or to Sunken Gardens. The company also runs a bike tour at Boyd Hill Nature Preserve and a paddleboard tour.

experiences.dt: Clearwater Municipal Marina, 25 Causeway Blvd.
experiences.du: Half-day trips 4 hours; grouper/snapper trips 12 hours
experiences.pr: Half day: adults $69 (+$7 rod rental), children 6-12 $39 (+$7 rod rental); bait fee and tax included. 12-hour grouper/snapper trip $225 plus $10 rod rental.
experiences.sc: Half-day trips 8:00 am-12:00 pm and 1:00-5:00 pm on Double Eagle III; the operator says trips are departing Thursday-Sunday at this time.
experiences.sm: Family-run party-boat fishing from Clearwater Beach since 1967: four-hour trips up to 10 miles offshore and 12-hour grouper and snapper trips. No fishing license is needed on the boat, and the boats have a galley and restrooms.
experiences.q: Friendly family owned and operated fishing business that has departed from Clearwater Beach, FL. Since 1967.

experiences.dt: Tampa Convention Center marina on the Riverwalk, 333 S Franklin St.
experiences.sm: Self-drive electric boats for up to 10 passengers, rented by the hour or with a guide, from the Tampa Convention Center marina.
experiences.q: Our boats comfortably fit up to 10 passengers and are available on an hourly basis or with a guide to customize your tour.

experiences.n: ECOmersion Weedon Island Kayak and Paddleboard Rentals and Tours
experiences.dt: Weedon Island Preserve, 1800 Weedon Dr. NE.
experiences.ad: 1800 Weedon Dr NE, St. Petersburg, FL
experiences.pr: Single kayak or paddleboard: 1 hour $28, 2 hours $45, 4 hours $55. Tandem kayak: 1 hour $40, 2 hours $70, 4 hours $80.
experiences.sc: Park hours 9:00-5:00; rental hours depend on the tides.
experiences.ag: Recommended for ages 8-80.
experiences.sm: Kayak and stand-up paddleboard rentals and guided kayak tours in Weedon Island Preserve's mangrove tunnels. The tunnels need at least a foot of water, so check the tide; the operator often sells out and recommends booking ahead.
experiences.q: Weedon Island is a 3,800 acre nature preserve located less than 20 minutes from downtown Tampa and St. Pete. It is a vital part of Tampa Bay, and has some of the longest mangrove tunnels on a contiguous paddling trail in the world!

experiences.dt: Mobbly Bayou Preserve, Oldsmar
experiences.pr: Starting at $49, per the Visit Tampa Bay listing
experiences.sc: 9am-5pm, 7 days a week, per the Visit Tampa Bay listing
experiences.ag: Ages 7+
experiences.sm: A guided 2.5-hour zip line course in Mobbly Bayou Preserve with 5 zip lines, aerial challenges and a 200-foot suspension bridge over the preserve, with views across Tampa Bay; reservations required.
experiences.q: This unforgettable 2.5-hour zip line adventure includes 5 zip-lines, numerous aerial adventure challenges, a 200' suspension bridge crossing and wide open water views across Tampa Bay.

experiences.pr: $75 per person, plus a general admission ticket
experiences.sc: Mondays, Tuesdays, Thursdays, Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays at 1:30 PM
experiences.ag: At least 8 years old
experiences.sm: A 45-minute behind-the-scenes session with the aquarium's animal care team and its African penguins, with a close meet-and-greet and a question-and-answer session; groups are capped at 8.
experiences.q: Enjoy a 45-minute interactive experience with exclusive access to one of The Florida Aquarium's most popular animal ambassadors.

experiences.dt: Heart of the Sea habitat, inside the aquarium
experiences.du: About one hour, with about 20 minutes underwater
experiences.pr: $75 per person, plus a general admission ticket
experiences.sc: Saturdays and Sundays, five sessions a day (start times vary); maximum four guests per session
experiences.ag: Ages 10 and up; no swimming required
experiences.sm: A guided underwater walk for non-divers through the coral caves of the aquarium's 15-foot-deep Heart of the Sea habitat, among Indo-Pacific fish and loggerhead sea turtles. Gear, including a wetsuit, is provided.
experiences.q: Take an aquatic adventure with SeaTREK, a guided underwater walking tour designed for non-divers ages 10 and up.

experiences.pr: $60 per person, plus a general admission ticket
experiences.sc: Wednesdays, Saturdays and Sundays at 11:30 AM; check in 15 minutes early
experiences.ag: 8 and older; ages 8-12 with an adult
experiences.sm: A small-group encounter (up to 10 guests) with a Linnaeus's two-toed sloth and its handlers, in which you feed the sloth and take photos; touching is not allowed.
experiences.q: Get up close and personal with one of our most elusive animal ambassadors during this unforgettable animal encounter.

experiences.pr: $30 per person, plus a general admission ticket
experiences.sc: Tuesdays, Thursdays, Saturdays and Sundays at 2:10 PM; check in 15 minutes early
experiences.ag: At least 8; ages 8-12 with an adult
experiences.sm: A 50-minute behind-the-scenes session for up to 6 people: you help prepare food in the commissary, then feed, touch and help train the aquarium's cownose stingrays.
experiences.q: Get closer to rays than ever before with exclusive, behind-the-scenes access during this 50-minute cownose stingray encounter.

experiences.dt: Launch near the aquarium's Outdoor Plaza; pick up a boarding wristband at Guest Services.
experiences.pr: $17 per adult; $15 per child (ages 3-11); free for children 2 and under; plus general admission.
experiences.sc: Weekdays: 1:00 PM and 2:30 PM, weather permitting.
experiences.sm: A naturalist-guided cruise on Tampa Bay aboard the aquarium's 72-foot catamaran, Bay Spirit II, looking for bottlenose dolphins and shorebirds. Each rider also needs a same-day aquarium general admission ticket.
experiences.q: Step aboard the Bay Spirit II, our 72-foot catamaran, where an experienced naturalist will guide you through the natural beauty of the Bay's ecosystem.

experiences.dt: Florida CraftArt gallery
experiences.du: About 90 minutes (10-11:30 a.m.); four blocks and back
experiences.pr: $25 adults; $15 children 6-18; free under 5
experiences.sc: Saturdays at 10:00 a.m.; reservations required
experiences.sm: A Saturday-morning walking tour from the Florida CraftArt gallery through the Central Arts District, telling the stories behind more than 30 murals in a four-block area; limited to 25 people.
experiences.q: Visitors will hear the inside stories of the making of over 30 murals found in the four-block tour.

experiences.dt: Museum ticket office and depot, Parrish
experiences.sc: Select weekends; the booking calendar lists departures at 11:00 AM (and 2:00 PM on Saturdays), e.g. Oct 3-4, Oct 31-Nov 1, Nov 14-15 and Nov 21-22, 2026
experiences.ag: All ages
experiences.sm: A 1.5-hour round-trip ride on historic railroad equipment over the museum's six-mile line from Parrish to Willow in rural Manatee County, run by volunteers in open-air and air-conditioned cars; special rides include a Train Robbery Experience and locomotive cab rides.
experiences.q: Enjoy a 1.5 hour round-trip excursion to Willow, FL on our historic railroad equipment.

experiences.op: Florida Southern College Frank Lloyd Wright Visitor Center
experiences.dt: Sharp Family Tourism and Education Center and GEICO Gift Shop, corner of Frank Lloyd Wright Way and Johnson Avenue
experiences.du: Basic tour 90 minutes; In-Depth tour 2.5 hours
experiences.pr: Basic tour $45; In-Depth tour $70; Usonian House tour $20 (10% off for AAA, AARP and military)
experiences.sc: Basic: 10:00 AM and 2:00 PM, 7 days a week; In-Depth: 10:30 AM and 1:00 PM, 7 days a week
experiences.sm: Docent-led walking tours of Florida Southern College's 13 Wright-designed structures, with visits inside the Annie Pfeiffer Chapel, the E.T. Roux Library and the Usonian Faculty House; the longer tour enters six buildings.

experiences.q: Have a large party? We can accommodate 36 people between all four Tiki Boats!

experiences.dt: Albert Whitted Airport, Hangar #2

experiences.sc: By appointment; one passenger plus the pilot
experiences.sm: Open-cockpit flights in a 1941 Army Stearman biplane from Albert Whitted Airport over downtown St. Petersburg and the Gulf beaches, with the option to take the controls or add loops and rolls.
experiences.q: Flights are by appointment for one passenger plus the pilot.

experiences.dt: Peter O. Knight Airport, Davis Islands

experiences.sm: Private helicopter flights from Peter O. Knight Airport over downtown Tampa, the Riverwalk, Davis and Harbour islands and, on longer routes, the beaches and Tampa Bay; routes include downtown, sunset and 'ultimate beach' tours.
experiences.q: All flights are private and depart from Peter O. Knight Airport on Davis Islands.

experiences.n: Fort De Soto Kayak Outpost (kayak and paddleboard rentals)

experiences.sc: Daily 9:30 am-4:30 pm, weather permitting; from May 16, 2026: 9:30 am-5:30 pm.
experiences.ag: All ages (per the booking page).
experiences.sm: The park concession's kayak and paddleboard rentals at Fort De Soto, for paddling the park's coves, shoreline and 2.25-mile canoe trail. The same vendor rents bikes, beach chairs and umbrellas.
experiences.q: The Kayak Outpost at Fort De Soto Park is the perfect starting point for an unforgettable adventure on the water.

experiences.dt: 135 NE 3rd St., Crystal River.
experiences.pr: Participants $70.95 (snorkel gear and wetsuit included); ride-along only (no swimming) $45.95; private tour for 12 or fewer $700.
experiences.sc: Daily, year-round.
experiences.ss: Year-round; the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service calls November 15 - March 31 manatee season in Kings Bay.
experiences.sm: A three-hour guided snorkel with manatees in Crystal River for up to 12 participants, with mask, snorkel and wetsuit included and an in-water guide throughout; non-swimmers can ride along. Scenic wildlife river cruises are also offered.
experiences.q: You have an in-water guide who is with you from arrival to departure, both on land and in the water.

experiences.n: Get Up and Go Kayaking Clearwater Clear Kayak Tours
experiences.dt: Launch point: Clearwater Beach Boat Ramp (the operator's address is 69 Bay Esplanade).
experiences.sm: Guided clear-kayak tours on the Intracoastal Waterway off Clearwater Beach, past the marina and waterfront homes, with a stop on a small boat-only bird-preserve island's sandbar. The operator calls it an open-water paddle that needs some comfort on the water and a moderate workout.
experiences.q: Step out onto the sandbar, explore the shoreline, and take in sweeping coastal views of the bustling Clearwater Bay.

experiences.n: Get Up and Go Kayaking Shell Key Preserve Clear Kayak Tours
experiences.dt: Tours launch from Tierra Verde, near St. Pete Beach.
experiences.du: Glow tour 1.5 hours; private tour 3 hours

experiences.ag: Glow tour ages 12+; private tour all ages.
experiences.sm: Guided tours in see-through kayaks to Shell Key Preserve's mangrove islands, beaches and sandbars, plus sunset and night 'glow' tours with LED-lit kayaks.
experiences.q: Wildlife encounters at Shell Key Preserve vary by season. In the summer, look for manatees and pink Roseate Spoonbills. During the winter, White Pelicans gather along the sandbars.

experiences.n: Get Up and Go Kayaking Tarpon Springs Clear Kayak Tours
experiences.dt: 307 Anclote Rd, Tarpon Springs.
experiences.pr: From $59.
experiences.ss: Manatee Season tour to Spring Bayou November-March; Sponge Docks & Mangroves tour on the Anclote River March-November.
experiences.ag: Ages 3+.
experiences.sm: Guided two-hour tours in see-through kayaks: in winter to Spring Bayou to look for manatees, and from March to November along the Anclote River past mangrove islands and the Sponge Docks. The operator notes the river's water is tea-colored from natural tannins.
experiences.q: Our clear kayak tour is a tranquil paddle through historic Tarpon Springs leading to Spring Bayou.

experiences.n: The Darkness Between Us Ghost Tour (Ybor City)

experiences.pr: $34.99 per person

experiences.q: The Darkness Between Us is our adults-only tour, and it walks the side of the cigar city the daylight version leaves out.

experiences.n: The Ghosts of Ybor City Tour
experiences.dt: Ybor City (exact meeting point confirmed at booking)
experiences.pr: $29.99 ages 12+; $14.99 ages 6-11; ages 0-5 free

experiences.ag: All ages
experiences.sm: An all-ages, 90-minute evening walk through Ybor City's historic district, mixing the history of the Cuban, Spanish and Italian cigar workers who built it with ghost stories; leashed dogs are welcome.
experiences.q: The Ghosts of Ybor City Tour is our all-ages walk through what they left behind.

experiences.dt: Sweet Divas Chocolates
experiences.pr: $24 per person; $16 ages 4-12
experiences.ag: Under 18 must be with an adult
experiences.sm: A candlelight walking tour of downtown St. Petersburg with a costumed guide, telling ghost stories drawn from the book Ghost Stories of St. Petersburg, FL, including the Vinoy's 'Lady in White'.
experiences.q: Peer into the shadows and mysteries of Florida's "Sunshine City" on a candlelight walking tour of downtown St. Petersburg!
experiences.sn: The operator's page (checked Sep 27, 2026) says it is open for private tours for parties of 6 or more through the winter and that regularly scheduled tours will resume in the spring.

experiences.op: St. Petersburg Museum of History with SPIRITS of St. Petersburg
experiences.dt: St. Petersburg Museum of History
experiences.sc: Wednesdays Oct 14, 21 and 28, 2026, 6:30-8:30 pm
experiences.sm: An evening trolley tour of downtown haunts and the Roser Park and Old Northeast neighborhoods, led by the SPIRITS of St. Petersburg paranormal group and departing from the Museum of History.
experiences.q: This ghostly tour takes you through the lesser-known haunts of downtown, as well as the haunted neighborhoods of Roser Park and the Old Northeast.

experiences.ag: Vehicle safari all ages; camel safari 3+; Segway safari 14+
experiences.sm: Guided safaris on a 47-acre Dade City ranch by 4-wheel-drive safari vehicle, camel, Segway or your own car (with the guide on FM radio), past zebra, tapir, deer and other animals.
experiences.q: Just like an African Safari, our custom vehicle safari is fully guided on our 4 wheel drive safari vehicles.

experiences.dt: Usually a RaceTrac gas station at 27140 SR-56, just east of I-75, about 1 hour before sunrise

experiences.sm: Sunrise hot air balloon flights over New Tampa, Wesley Chapel and Zephyrhills, with up to 4 or 5 passengers per basket; flights go only in light winds and clear skies.
experiences.q: We always fly at sunrise when the winds are most calm, temperatures are cooler, and the views are spectacular as the Sun rises over the horizon.

experiences.sm: Private, by-appointment airboat tours of west-central Florida backwaters with a licensed captain, customizable for sightseeing, sunset or wildlife watching; the operator also runs shallow-water fishing trips and guided alligator hunts in season.
experiences.q: To provide a real Florida airboat experience — not a crowded, commercial ride.

experiences.dt: Bradenton Riverwalk Pier in downtown Bradenton, the Historic Bridge Street Pier on Anna Maria Island, and a Coquina Beach stop.

experiences.sm: A passenger ferry between downtown Bradenton's Riverwalk and Anna Maria Island's Bridge Street Pier, with a short hop to Coquina Beach; on the island the free trolley connects the beaches.
experiences.q: The Ferry operates Thursdays thru Sundays between The Bradenton Riverwalk and The Historic Bridge Street Pier on Anna Maria Island

experiences.n: Gulp Coast Craft Beer Trail passport

experiences.sm: A self-guided brewery passport from the county tourism office: you sign up, check in at participating breweries for deals, and collect enough stops to claim a Gulp Coast T-shirt.
experiences.q: This passport is your guide to St. Pete-Clearwater's craft beer scene.

experiences.n: Henry B. Plant Museum guided and audio tours

experiences.sm: The museum in the 1891 Tampa Bay Hotel offers one-hour docent-led tours for groups of 10 or more (January-October, by reservation) and a complimentary 45-minute audio guide for visitors exploring on their own.
experiences.q: Explore the Museum at your own pace with a brochure and enjoy our complimentary audio tour conveniently downloaded to your personal device.

experiences.n: Canoe and Kayak Rentals in Hillsborough County Parks

experiences.sm: Hillsborough County rents canoes and kayaks at several of its parks for paddling rivers, creeks and bay shorelines. Rentals may be suspended or stopped early when small craft advisories are issued.
experiences.q: Try a leisurely paddle, swift-moving journey, or a bit of an adventure on Hillsborough County's rivers, creeks and waterways.

experiences.n: Historic Downtown St. Pete Trolley Tour
experiences.dt: St. Petersburg Museum of History
experiences.sc: Next listed: Saturday, Oct 3, 2026, 9:00-11:00 am
experiences.sm: A museum-led trolley tour of the people, piers, railroads, waterfront parks and neighborhoods that shaped St. Petersburg, from Thrill Hill and Roser Park to Coffee Pot and Mirror Lake, run with Star Trolley.
experiences.q: Climb aboard and discover the dreamers and schemers who created St. Petersburg!

experiences.n: Egmont Key Ferry from Fort De Soto
experiences.dt: Fort De Soto Park (the page names both the Bay Pier and the Boat Ramp); the county park charges $6 per car to enter.

experiences.ss: Daily in spring and summer and nearly every day in fall and winter.
experiences.sm: A ferry from Fort De Soto Park to Egmont Key State Park, where you get about three hours for the beach, shelling and the Fort Dade ruins; the island has no restrooms or shops, so bring water and food. A snorkeling add-on is sold on the day when conditions allow.
experiences.q: Egmont Key is a pristine island, so there isn't a bathroom or any type of shop on the island so make sure to come prepared with a cooler full of water, food and drinks.

experiences.n: Hubbard's Marina Deep Sea Fishing (Party Boats)
experiences.dt: Hubbard's Marina, John's Pass, Madeira Beach.

experiences.q: Family owned and operated since 1928, Hubbard's Marina offers deep sea fishing, dolphin watching, island adventures, private charters, and unforgettable experiences on Florida Gulf Coast.

experiences.dt: Hubbard's Marina, John's Pass Village, Madeira Beach.
experiences.ad: 170 Johns Pass Boardwalk, Madeira Beach, FL 33708
experiences.pr: Adult (12-64) $29.95; senior (65+) $26.95; child (3-11) $14.95; infants 2 and under free (must be on the reservation).
experiences.sc: 11am, 1pm, 3pm and 5pm daily.
experiences.sm: A 90-minute narrated cruise from John's Pass over Madeira Beach waters looking for bottlenose dolphins, with views of John's Pass Village and Treasure Island. Hubbard's guarantees dolphin sightings or your next trip is free.

experiences.n: Shell Key Ferry from Fort De Soto

experiences.sm: A ferry from Fort De Soto Park's boat ramp to Shell Key, an uninhabited barrier-island preserve with no shops or restrooms, for beach time and shelling; choose a return pickup, or camp overnight with a camper ticket and a permit.
experiences.q: There are no facilities on the island, so come prepared with a cooler of food, drinks, and water.

experiences.sm: Wind-tunnel flights with certified instructors, sold as packages of 2, 3, 5 or 10 flights (some shareable) and off-peak 'Super Saver' deals; the company says it is for all ages. Arrive 15 minutes early in lace-up sneakers.
experiences.q: Experience indoor skydiving at iFLY Tampa, Florida. Fun for all ages with IBA-certified instructors.

experiences.n: Cigar Hand Rolling Class at El Reloj
experiences.dt: The American Room, El Reloj Cigar Factory
experiences.sc: Offered on select days and times
experiences.sm: Sit with J.C. Newman's cigar makers and learn to apply wrapper leaf and finish five cigars by hand; you take the five cigars home.
experiences.q: Take a seat alongside our cigar makers in The American Room and learn to hand roll your own cigars the same way that J.C. Newman has been doing for more than 100 years.

experiences.dt: El Reloj Cigar Factory, corner of North 16th Street and East Columbus Drive
experiences.sc: Offered on select days and times; the factory is open to visitors Monday-Friday 9AM-5PM
experiences.ag: Guests of all ages may take the guided factory tour
experiences.sm: A historian leads you through production areas of J.C. Newman's El Reloj factory that are closed to the public, from tobacco aging to rolling and packaging, plus the company's archives. Entry to the factory's museum and exhibits is free; the company says El Reloj is America's last traditional cigar factory.
experiences.q: Step inside El Reloj, America’s last traditional cigar factory, and learn how cigars built Tampa and made it world famous as Cigar City.

experiences.n: Hillsborough River Canoe and Kayak Rentals at John B. Sargeant Conservation Park
experiences.dt: Park office at John B. Sargeant Sr. Conservation Park, on the Hillsborough River at US 301.
experiences.pr: Local rental (one park) for up to four hours: $25; each additional hour $10 (fees include tax).
experiences.sc: Canoe and kayak rentals 7 days a week from 8 AM until 1 PM.
experiences.sm: The county rents canoes and kayaks at the park office for paddling the Hillsborough River State Canoe Trail through hardwood swamp downstream, or the wide Seventeen Runs upstream. Rentals may be suspended during small craft advisories.
experiences.q: Downriver, the Hillsborough River State Canoe Trail winds through a jungle of hardwood trees, lilies, and wading birds and is popular for both new and experienced paddlers.

experiences.ag: Under 18 need a parent or guardian to sign the waiver. Combined weight limits (about 130-165 lbs minimum and 450-550 lbs maximum) change daily with the wind, at the captain's discretion.
experiences.sm: Parasail trips from John's Pass Village on three 12-passenger boats: you launch from and land on the deck, flying two or three side by side on 800 feet of towline (the operator notes the FAA's 400-foot height limit).
experiences.q: Fly two or three at a time using the latest in parasailing equipment.

experiences.n: Latitudes Tours Eco Tours, Dinner Cruises and Kayak Tours

experiences.sc: Daily tours Tuesday through Sunday: morning eco tours, 12:30 eco tours with optional lunch, sunset cruises with dinner, guided kayak tours.
experiences.sm: Narrated boat tours from Ruskin on the south shore of Tampa Bay through the bay estuary and the Little Manatee River, looking for dolphins, manatees and birds, with optional lunch or dinner; guided kayak tours too.
experiences.q: Join our expert captain and naturalist for a captivating 2-hour eco-tour through the breathtaking Tampa Bay Estuary.

experiences.sm: Two-hour cruises on Sarasota Bay aboard a barge dressed as a floating island with four real palm trees: a narrated dolphin and manatee watch, a sightseeing cruise and a sunset cruise with cocktails and island music.
experiences.q: Escape to the tropics on Sarasota Bay aboard our one-of-a-kind floating island.

experiences.dt: Clearwater Beach Marina, 25 Causeway Blvd., Slip 12.
experiences.ad: 25 Causeway Blvd, Slip 12, Clearwater Beach, FL 33767

experiences.sc: Little Toot II daily at 11am, 1pm, 3pm, 5pm and a sunset tour; Original Little Toot select days at 10am, 12pm, 2pm and 4pm.
experiences.sm: Dolphin and sightseeing tours of Clearwater Harbor and the Gulf on two boats, the Original Little Toot and Little Toot II. The operator guarantees a dolphin sighting or a free trip within a year of the first.
experiences.q: Dolphin sighting guaranteed! Or your next trip is free within 1 year of 1st trip.

experiences.sm: A 1.5-hour pirate-themed cruise from downtown Tampa for all ages: children train as pirates with games and water-cannon battles while adults can use the full bar (drinks and snacks are extra). The crew looks for dolphins but does not guarantee sightings.
experiences.q: Come aboard the Lost Pearl for a 1.5-hour pirate adventure out in Tampa Bay! Become a part of our pirate crew with swashbuckling training, water gun battles and more!

experiences.n: Madeira Beach Couples Jet Ski Tours

experiences.sm: Guided jet ski tours from Madeira Beach: shared or private Intracoastal rides past John's Pass and waterfront neighborhoods, or private tours that add Gulf riding and a stop at Shell Key. Water, snacks and photos are included.

experiences.n: Makin' Waves Jet Ski and Beach Rentals

experiences.sm: Beach concession behind Shephard's Beach Resort on Clearwater Beach renting jet skis, paddleboards, kayaks, chairs and umbrellas. Jet ski riders born after Dec 31, 1987 must show a boating safety certificate; the operator links to an online test.
experiences.q: Take off on a Jet Ski, cruise on a Paddle Board, or explore the water by Kayak!

experiences.op: Morean Arts Center (Morean Glass Studio & Hot Shop)

experiences.dt: Tampa Bay Brewing Company, Ybor City
experiences.du: About two and a half hours
experiences.sm: A walking ghost tour and pub crawl through Ybor City led by a guide dressed as a pirate; it starts at Tampa Bay Brewing Company and stops at local pubs along the way.
experiences.q: From there you will walk through the city for about two and a half hours with your pirate guide, making a few stops at local pubs to try and find multiple forms of spirits.

experiences.n: The Official Downtown Tampa Ghost Tour
experiences.dt: Listed at 711 N Franklin St (Tampa Theatre); meeting point not confirmed
experiences.sm: A downtown ghost walk with stories of yellow-fever mass graves, mobsters and murders, with stops at Tampa Theatre, the Sapphire Room at the Hotel Floridan and Sacred Heart Church, per the operator's tourism listing.
experiences.q: Factual stories of history and horror await.

experiences.n: The Official Ybor City Food Tour
experiences.dt: Listed at 1601 E 7th Ave, Ybor City
experiences.sm: A guided food walk through Ybor City with tastings at locally owned breweries, restaurants, hotels and cigar bars, and visits inside historic buildings; it ends with a cigar and Cuban coffee, per the listing.
experiences.q: Sample the dishes that tell the story of an immigrant town that rose from a swampy 40-acres to one of the biggest Industry Towns in America.

experiences.n: The Official Ybor City Ghost Tour
experiences.dt: Listed at 1523 E 7th Ave, Ybor City; meeting point not confirmed
experiences.sm: A guided ghost walk through Ybor City that mixes the district's immigrant and cigar-industry history with stories of villains, gangsters and buildings the operator describes as haunted.
experiences.q: Tampa‘s famous “Latin District” has no lack of strange and creepy happenings.

experiences.dt: Courtyard by Marriott Clearwater Beach Marina, 455 E Shore Dr. (the page also calls it the Papaya Street Plaza Docks).

experiences.pr: 2-Hour Scenic Cruise $49; Daily 3-Hour Sandbar Tour from $59.
experiences.sm: BYOB cruises from Clearwater Beach on a boat for up to 20 with a bathroom on board: a two-hour island-hop and dolphin-watch cruise, a sunset cruise with party lights and a three-hour sandbar trip.
experiences.q: Explore the vibrant heart of Clearwater in style with our Island Hop and Dolphin Watch!

experiences.dt: Boards at 333 S Franklin St (Tampa Convention Center docks).

experiences.sm: A two-hour BYOB cruise on the Hillsborough River aboard a pedal-powered party boat with motor assist, a captain and a deckhand host. Book a single seat on a public cruise or the whole boat for up to 16.
experiences.q: Cruise Tampa's skyline on Paddle Pub! Bring your drinks, dance to great music, and party with your crew while your deckhand host keeps the energy up with games and prizes, shot ski, karaoke and more!

experiences.n: Paramount Water Sports Guided Jet Ski Rides

experiences.q: Have a Certified Guide lead you or your group out to the bay to enjoy an exciting ride on the ocean, all while seeing beautiful views of the Davis Island Waterfront mansions, the University of Tampa, and the Downtown Business District.

experiences.q: One Parasail Flight at your desired height will last approximately 10 minutes.

experiences.sm: A planned ferry between downtown Tampa and downtown St. Petersburg that succeeds the former Cross-Bay Ferry. PSTA bought two vessels, Bay Breeze and Clipper, for the service, which Hubbard's will operate.
experiences.sn: Not yet running as of Sep 27, 2026: the service's own site (tampabayferry.com) says 'SERVICE COMING SOON'. PSTA (June 22, 2026): no launch date confirmed. St. Pete Rising (Aug 18, 2026): launch expected later in 2026 after refurbishment and inspections, seven days a week, one-way fares targeted at $10 with discounts planned for seniors and riders with disabilities; schedule not yet final.

experiences.n: Beach Drive food tour, St. Pete
experiences.dt: Bella Brava, Beach Drive
experiences.sc: Thursdays, 4:30pm-7:30pm (based on availability)
experiences.ag: Recommended for ages 12 and older
experiences.sm: A 3-hour walking food tour of St. Petersburg's Beach Drive waterfront district, starting at Bella Brava and passing the Vinoy and the St. Pete Pier.

experiences.n: Central Avenue food tour, St. Pete
experiences.dt: Bavaro's, Central Avenue (EDGE District)
experiences.sc: Saturdays, 12:00pm-3:00pm (based on availability)
experiences.ag: Recommended for ages 12 and older
experiences.sm: A 3-hour walking food tour of St. Petersburg's Central Avenue and EDGE District for 6 to 14 people, starting with Neapolitan food at Bavaro's; all of the company's tours include at least three alcoholic pairings.

experiences.n: Tastes and Tales of Downtown Tampa food tour
experiences.dt: Spain Restaurant and Toma Bar
experiences.sc: Tuesdays, 5:30pm-8:30pm (based on availability)
experiences.ag: Recommended for ages 12 and older
experiences.sm: A 3-hour evening walking food tour of downtown Tampa for 6 to 14 people, starting at Spain Restaurant and Toma Bar, with tastings and at least three alcoholic pairings.

experiences.dt: Lucky Lobster
experiences.sc: Saturdays and Sundays, 1:00pm-4:00pm (based on availability)
experiences.ag: Recommended for ages 12 and older
experiences.sm: A 3-hour walking food tour of downtown Dunedin that starts with a drink and lobster-and-shrimp pizza at Lucky Lobster and continues with seated tastings at local eateries.

experiences.dt: United Smokehouse, Safety Harbor
experiences.sc: Saturdays, 1:00pm-4:00pm (based on availability)
experiences.ag: Recommended for ages 12 and older
experiences.sm: A 3-hour walking food tour of Safety Harbor that starts with barbecue at United Smokehouse, visits specialty food shops and ends with dessert.

experiences.n: Tampa Bay Fun Boat Sightseeing Tour
experiences.dt: Tampa Convention Center boat docks, at the seawall in front of the Sail Pavilion at the entrance to the marina.
experiences.pr: Guests 13 and older $25; children 3-12 $12; children 2 and under free (must be on the reservation).
experiences.sc: Departure times on the operator's calendar; sunset tours also offered.
experiences.sm: A 90-minute public sightseeing tour on a 35-passenger deck boat past Davis Islands and Harbour Island, with narration on local history and homes and a lookout for dolphins. You may bring a small cooler and your own drinks, and pets are welcome.
experiences.q: On this scenic cruise you will see some of the homes of Tampa's rich and famous as well as learn some of the history of Davis Islands and Harbor Island all while searching for dolphins and other wildlife!

experiences.n: College Hill Black History Walking Tour
experiences.dt: C. Blythe Andrews Jr. Public Library (the tour does not depart from the History Center)
experiences.ad: 2607 E Dr Martin Luther King Jr Blvd, Tampa, FL 33610
experiences.pr: $25 (History Center members save 20%)
experiences.sm: Historian Fred Hearns leads a 90-minute walk through College Hill in East Tampa, one of the city's oldest Black communities, with stops at the C. Blythe Andrews Jr. Public Library, Belmont Heights Estates, Memorial Park Cemetery (established 1923) and Belmont Heights Little League. Tours are limited to 25 people.
experiences.q: In the late 1800s, Black families began purchasing lots in the area after being promised that a college for Black students would be built nearby.

experiences.dt: Lykes Gaslight Square Park
experiences.du: 90 minutes; about one mile of walking
experiences.pr: $25 (History Center members save 20%)
experiences.sc: Saturdays Oct 10 and Dec 12, 2026, 10:00-11:30 a.m.
experiences.sm: A 90-minute, one-mile guided walk past Old City Hall, Sacred Heart Catholic Church, the Floridan Palace Hotel and The Hub, covering the architecture, industries and communities that shaped downtown. Advance tickets are required and each tour is limited to 25 guests.
experiences.q: Learn about Tampa’s compelling history as you stroll past City Hall, Sacred Heart Church, the Floridan Palace Hotel and even Tampa’s oldest bar, The Hub, on this guided trek!

experiences.dt: Tampa's Black History Museum
experiences.pr: $25 (History Center members save 20%)
experiences.sc: Saturday, Dec 19, 2026 and Saturday, Apr 10, 2027, 10:00-11:30 a.m.
experiences.sm: Historian Fred Hearns leads a 90-minute, seven-block walk through the ENCORE! neighborhood and Perry Harvey Sr. Park, covering Central Avenue's history as the center of Black business, culture and music in Tampa from the 1890s through the 1960s. Advance tickets are required and the tour is limited to 25 guests.
experiences.q: Guests will discover Central Avenue’s musical legacy and the people, businesses and gathering places that shaped African American life during segregation.

experiences.dt: South entrance of Oaklawn Cemetery, on Harrison Street between Morgan and Jefferson streets
experiences.pr: $25 (History Center members save 20%)
experiences.sc: Saturday, Oct 31, 2026 and Saturday, Feb 13, 2027, 10:00-11:30 a.m.
experiences.sm: A 90-minute guided walk through Oaklawn Cemetery, established in 1850, which the History Center calls Tampa's oldest public burial ground; stops include graves of 13 Tampa mayors, a Florida governor, enslaved people and Vicente Martinez-Ybor. Advance tickets are required and each tour is limited to 25 guests.
experiences.q: Although Oaklawn is often associated with local legends and mystery, the tour centers on documented history and the lives of the people buried there.

experiences.n: West Tampa Black History Walking Tour
experiences.dt: The flagpole by the Bob Buckhorn River Center inside Julian B. Lane Riverfront Park
experiences.du: 90 minutes; about eight blocks of walking
experiences.pr: $25 (History Center members save 20%)
experiences.sc: Saturday, Nov 28, 2026 and Saturday, Mar 13, 2027, 10:00-11:30 a.m.
experiences.sm: Historian Fred Hearns leads a 90-minute, eight-block walk through sites of West Tampa's Black history, including the former site of J. W. Roberts City, the University of Tampa's I. W. Phillips Field and Clara Frye Memorial Hospital. Advance tickets are required and the tour is limited to 25 guests.
experiences.q: Visitors from outside Tampa will discover how West Tampa’s cigar industry, community institutions and Black residents contributed to the development of the wider Tampa Bay region.

experiences.dt: Parque Amigos de José Martí (Friends of José Martí Park)
experiences.du: 90 minutes; about one mile of walking
experiences.pr: $25 (History Center members save 20%)
experiences.sc: Saturday, Nov 21, 2026, 10:00-11:30 a.m. (the date listed as of Sep 27, 2026); History Center tours run on select Saturdays at 10 a.m.
experiences.sm: A 90-minute docent-led walk of about a mile through Ybor City's brick streets, cigar factories, social clubs and 7th Avenue, run by the Tampa Bay History Center on select Saturdays. Advance tickets are required and each tour is limited to 25 guests.
experiences.q: Guests will learn how Ybor developed as a central hub of the United States’ cigar industry and how it emerged as a rare multi-ethnic and multi-racial industrial community in the Deep South in the late 19th and early 20th centuries.

experiences.op: Tampa Bay Sunset Sail (Time & Tide Captain Services)
experiences.dt: Downtown St. Petersburg (Visit St. Pete/Clearwater gives 500 1st Ave SE).
experiences.sm: Two-hour sunset sails for up to six guests on a 47-foot sailboat with a professional captain, along downtown St. Petersburg's waterfront and past the St. Pete Pier; book a shared or a private sail.
experiences.q: We spend as much of the evening as possible exclusively under sail power

experiences.dt: Listed at 107 N. Franklin St, downtown Tampa
experiences.sc: Tuesday through Sunday
experiences.sm: A 90-minute guided walk through downtown Tampa's history, including the site of Fort Brooke, Plant Hall, the Hotel Floridan Palace and Tampa Theatre, offered Tuesday through Sunday.
experiences.q: Come along a 90-minute stroll through the shade and learn why Tampa is one of the most unique cities in America.

experiences.dt: Listed at 1601 E 7th Ave, Ybor City
experiences.sm: A guided walking tour of Ybor City's history of cigar manufacturing, immigration, organized crime and the Cuban independence movement, run by Tampa Bay Tours, which also runs the Ybor ghost and food tours.
experiences.q: Now one of only three National Historic Landmark Districts in Florida, Ybor City’s unique history will come alive as you walk the area with award winning guides.

experiences.n: Tampa Bay Watch Discovery Center Wildlife Boat Tours
experiences.dt: Eco-vessel Discovery at Gate 23, St. Petersburg Municipal Marina, on the St. Pete Pier approach (not at the Discovery Center itself).
experiences.ad: 400 2nd Ave NE, Slip Q47, St. Petersburg, FL 33701
experiences.du: Wildlife tour 90 min; Liquid to Land history tour 120 min; sandbar snorkeling 120 min; sunset tour 60 min
experiences.pr: Starting prices: Wildlife Boat Tour $20; Sunset Tour $18; Sandbar Snorkeling $26; Liquid to Land History Tour $45.
experiences.ss: Wildlife, sunset and history tours year round; sandbar snorkeling seasonally.
experiences.ag: Sandbar snorkeling ages 5 and up, with an adult.
experiences.sm: Marine science educators from the nonprofit Tampa Bay Watch run wildlife tours on a floating classroom that include a fisheries trawl and citizen-science data collection, plus sunset, history and sandbar snorkeling trips. Proceeds support bay restoration.
experiences.q: Every wildlife tour aboard the Discovery includes wildlife watching, a fisheries trawl to take a closer look at common local species, and an opportunity to participate in real scientific research.

experiences.dt: Grand Cathedral Cigars (pick-up and drop-off)
experiences.sm: A 3-hour minibus tour of Tampa cigar lounges, including Grand Cathedral Cigars, Sterling Cigar Lounge, King Corona Cigars and La Faraona Cigar Factory, with Ybor City history from the guide and a pass by the J.C. Newman factory.
experiences.q: Tampa Minibus Tours is ready to take you for a taste of the Cigar Capital of the World.

experiences.dt: In front of Hotel Flor, Florida Ave entrance
experiences.pr: Adults $44.99
experiences.ag: All ages
experiences.sm: A 2.5-hour small-group tour in a 12-passenger air-conditioned minibus with stops at the Tampa postcard mural, Sparkman Wharf and Armature Works, plus Ybor City, the Riverwalk, Bayshore Boulevard and the history of the Central Avenue Scrub neighborhood.
experiences.q: Explore the great city of Tampa on a small group city Bus tour.

experiences.n: Tampa Terrors Spirits & Spirits Haunted Pub Crawl
experiences.dt: 601 N Florida Ave, downtown Tampa
experiences.pr: Starting at $29; drinks not included
experiences.sm: A two-hour walking pub crawl with four stops in downtown Tampa and ghost stories along the way; the ticket does not include drinks.
experiences.q: This tour price does not include tastings or tours of the facilities.

experiences.n: Tides of Tethered Terror: Tampa Ghost Tours
experiences.dt: Tampa Theatre
experiences.pr: Starting at $26
experiences.sc: Nightly at 8:00 PM and 9:00 PM, rain or shine
experiences.sm: A one-hour evening ghost walk through downtown Tampa that starts at Tampa Theatre, with stories tied to sites such as the Fort Brooke parking garage; an extended version adds more stops.
experiences.q: Ghost tours are held nightly, rain or shine!

experiences.n: The Pelican Egmont Key Boat Tour
experiences.dt: St. Pete Pier area: Dock Q48, Gate 24, 400 2nd Avenue NE.
experiences.ad: 400 2nd Ave NE, Dock Q48, Gate 24, St. Petersburg, FL 33701
experiences.du: 4 hours: about 1 hour each way plus about 2 hours on Egmont Key
experiences.pr: Adults $69; children 12 and under $49.
experiences.sm: A 60-foot passenger boat runs from downtown St. Petersburg under the Sunshine Skyway Bridge to Egmont Key, where you get about two hours to swim, snorkel (gear provided) and walk to the Fort Dade ruins and lighthouse. The boat stays docked at the island, which has no restrooms or drinking water.
experiences.q: Unlike the ferry, The Pelican will remain docked at the island for you to have access to our facilities, as the island does not have amenities like restrooms or drinking water.

experiences.dt: Clearwater Beach Municipal Marina, 25 Causeway Blvd; check in 45 minutes before departure.
experiences.ag: Appropriate for all ages.
experiences.sm: Daily dolphin-watching tours and sunset cruises on a 126-passenger double-decker catamaran that runs out Clearwater Pass into the Gulf, with guaranteed dolphin sightings on the dolphin tour, captain's narration and an onboard bar. No outside food or drink.
experiences.q: Our tour will take you from Clearwater Bay out Clearwater Pass on the beautiful emerald green waters of the Gulf of Mexico in search of the Sun Coast's favorite….the Bottlenose Dolphin.

experiences.dt: The Western Docks at Armature Works, 1910 N Ola Ave.
experiences.du: 90-minute tours; customizable tours up to 4 hours
experiences.ag: Family friendly; you must be 21 (ID checked) to bring alcohol.
experiences.sm: A 12-passenger tiki boat with a bathroom on board that tours the Hillsborough River past Davis Island and Harbour Island and back. Groups of 6 to 12 book the boat; you bring your own food and drinks.
experiences.q: We have a 90 minute tour traveling the Hillsborough River, Davis Island, Harbour Island and back.

experiences.n: Tiki Island Cruises: Tiki Getaway BYOB
experiences.dt: Clearwater Beach Marina, 25 Causeway Boulevard; check in at ticket booth #4 (Calypso Queen/Tiki Island Cruises).
experiences.pr: Adults (13+) $24.50; children (12 and under) $19.50.
experiences.ag: All ages.
experiences.sm: A narrated, open-air tiki-boat cruise from Clearwater Beach Marina with music and a possible stop at a small barrier island, weather permitting. You may bring a personal cooler (no glass).
experiences.q: As you embark on this tiki tour, your friendly boat crew will share fun facts and interesting stories about the area's rich history, famous residents and harbor landmarks.

experiences.dt: Downtown St. Petersburg at the St. Pete Pier; the operator also lists Rocky Point Island and the Tampa Riverwalk.
experiences.pr: Public day tour (St. Petersburg): $59 per adult, $49 per child 12 and under (4-passenger minimum, 6 maximum). Private day tour: $354 for up to 6, $59 each additional person (13 maximum).
experiences.sc: Public tours by reservation only, not on Saturdays; private day and sunset tours.
experiences.sm: Two-hour BYOB tiki-boat tours with stops at shallow sandbars for a swim, sold by the seat on public tours or as a private boat for up to 13; water and iced coolers are provided.
experiences.q: All locations can make stops at shallow/sandbar areas for you and your group to take a dip in the Bay.

experiences.ad: 27839 Saint Joe Rd, Dade City, FL 33525
experiences.pr: 3-Hour Climb: adults (12+) $68.95; children 7-11 $48.25; ages 5-6 $26.75; $6 more at the door
experiences.sc: Open-climb hours vary by day (for example 9am-6pm or 10am-4pm); see the calendar
experiences.ag: Ages 5 and up on the main courses; a Little Lemurs course for ages 1-6
experiences.sm: A forest ropes-course park in Dade City with 9 courses and more than 100 elements, including zip lines; a ticket buys 3 hours of climbing, and a separate small course serves children as young as 1.
experiences.q: 3 hours of climbing on 9 courses with 100+ different elements (some age restrictions apply – see our course rules for details)

experiences.sm: An aerial adventure park east of Bradenton with ropes and zip-line courses, plus gem mining, mini golf and the TreeTops cafe.

experiences.n: Urban Kai Stand Up Paddleboard Rentals, Tours and Lessons
experiences.dt: Urban Kai shop, 310 W 7th Ave, on the Hillsborough River.
experiences.sm: Stand-up paddleboard shop on the Hillsborough River in Tampa that offers board rentals, guided kayak and paddleboard tours, lessons and fitness classes.
experiences.q: In Tampa and St. Petersburg Florida, Urban Kai Stand Up Paddle Board Shop, the original SUP shop of Tampa, (located on the Hillsborough River) is teaching, touring and offering fitness classes for stand up paddling.

experiences.dt: Check in at the office, 8103 Cortez Blvd; staff then send you to the company's private dock, about 5 minutes' drive away.
experiences.du: No hourly time limit; boats due back by 5:00
experiences.pr: Single kayak $45; tandem kayak $60 (life vests and paddles included).
experiences.sc: Monday-Sunday 9 AM-5 PM.
experiences.sm: Kayak rentals on the spring-fed Weeki Wachee River: launch from the company's private dock, paddle upriver as far as you like and float back. The dock is about a 12-minute paddle from Hospital Hole, where the operator says manatees are most often seen.
experiences.q: We do not restrict how far or where you can go on the river.

experiences.dt: Several rental points: Holiday Inn Clearwater Beach (521 S Gulfview Blvd), JW Marriott Clearwater Beach (691 S Gulfview Blvd), Chart House Suites (850 Bayway Blvd), Sheraton Sand Key (1160 Gulf Blvd), Marriott Suites on Sand Key (1201 Gulf Blvd) and the Clearwater Beach Marina, 25 Causeway Blvd (guided jet ski tours, sunset/dolphin and tiki boat tours).
experiences.du: Freestyle rentals 30 minutes or 1 hour; guided jet ski tours 90 minutes or 2 hours; sunset/dolphin and tiki boat tours 90 minutes
experiences.sm: Jet ski, JetCar, water-trike, boat and banana-boat rentals at Clearwater Beach and Sand Key hotels, plus guided jet ski tours and 90-minute sunset, dolphin and tiki boat tours from the Clearwater Beach Marina.
experiences.q: Wet Rentals & Tours offers the best watercraft experiences on the Gulf Coast — from freestyle jet ski rides to guided island tours and sunset cruises.

experiences.n: Wet Rentals & Tours at the Westin Tampa Bay
experiences.dt: Westin Tampa Bay, 7627 W. Courtney Campbell Causeway.
experiences.ad: 7627 W Courtney Campbell Cswy, Tampa, FL 33607
experiences.sm: Jet ski and JetCar rentals on Tampa Bay by the Courtney Campbell Causeway, plus paddleboard and kayak rentals at this location.
experiences.q: Conveniently located at the Westin Tampa Bay on the scenic Courtney Campbell Causeway, our team offers everything from high-speed freestyle jet skiing to relaxing paddleboard sessions.

experiences.dt: Downtown Tampa
experiences.pr: $15 per adult; children and students with an adult walk free
experiences.sc: Evening tours that begin at sunset, plus some daytime tours; dates on the booking page
experiences.ag: Children and students accompanied by an adult are free
experiences.sm: A Black history walking tour of downtown Tampa that visits the sites of Black-owned businesses, neighborhoods and entertainment venues that have since disappeared; many tours run after dark, and daytime tours are also offered.
experiences.q: Walk Downtown Tampa with us and discover the Black businesses, neighborhoods, people, and places that helped build this city.

experiences.sm: ATV rentals in a 2,600-acre off-road park near Brooksville, ridden either self-guided with a trail map or with a guide; helmets, eye protection and a safety briefing are included.
experiences.q: Explore Miles of ATV Trails Across Our 2,600-Acre Brooksville Park - Book Now!

experiences.n: Woody's Watersports Jet Ski Rentals and Tours
experiences.dt: The company's docks inside John's Pass (Visit St. Pete/Clearwater gives 205 Boardwalk Place E, John's Pass Village).
experiences.pr: Jet ski rental starting at $70.
experiences.ag: A temporary boater's license is required for all operators born after January 1, 1988.
experiences.sm: Family-run jet ski rentals from docks inside John's Pass, a couple of minutes from open Gulf water, plus a guided John's Pass jet ski tour through the village waterfront and Boca Ciega Bay.
experiences.q: From our dock it takes just two minutes to be in the open waters of the Gulf of Mexico!

experiences.dt: Clearwater Beach Marina, 25 Causeway Boulevard, Slip #55.
experiences.pr: Dinner + sunset cruise from $69.95 adult, $49.95 child (ages 2-12); sunset cruise-only from $39.95 adult, $29.95 child; under 2 complimentary. Prices change.
experiences.sc: Sunset cruises generally depart around 30 minutes before sunset; departure times depend on the date.
experiences.sm: Two-hour sunset dinner cruise aboard Yacht StarShip IV on the Intracoastal Waterway off Clearwater Beach, with a buffet, a DJ and an included open bar (four-drink limit on cruise-only tickets).
experiences.q: In Clearwater, you'll cruise the scenic Intercoastal Waterway viewing million-dollar mansions, an occasional pod of playful dolphins and a scenic West Coast sunset in Clearwater Pass or the Gulf of Mexico, weather permitting.

experiences.dt: 603 Channelside Drive, downtown Tampa (Pirate Water Taxi stop 2 is Sparkman Wharf / Yacht StarShip / Craft).
experiences.du: 2-hour cruise (boarding starts 30 minutes prior to sail time)
experiences.pr: Tampa Dinner Cruise from $79.95 adult, $54.95 child (ages 2-12); cruise-only from $49.95 adult, $29.95 child; under 2 complimentary. Brunch and lunch cruises from $59.95 adult. Prices change.
experiences.sc: Dinner cruise times vary by date; Tampa Brunch Cruise 12:30-2:30 PM on weekends.
experiences.sm: Two-hour dining cruises from downtown Tampa past waterfront mansions and the seaport into Tampa Bay, with a buffet, a DJ and, on select cruises, an included open bar. Brunch, lunch, dinner and themed special-event cruises are offered.
experiences.q: In Tampa, you'll cruise by million-dollar mansions and Florida's largest seaport, en route to beautiful Tampa Bay.

experiences.dt: Yuengling Draft Haus & Kitchen
experiences.sc: Draft Haus open Wednesday-Thursday 11AM-10PM, Friday-Saturday 11AM-11PM, Sunday 11AM-10PM; closed Monday-Tuesday
experiences.sm: The Yuengling Draft Haus & Kitchen at Yuengling's Tampa brewery takes bookings for a brewery tour through its reservation page; the Draft Haus, opened in 2023, has a restaurant, an outdoor recreation area and displays of Yuengling artifacts and advertising memorabilia.

experiences.sc: Hotshop workshops Wednesdays and Fridays 4-9pm, Saturdays 10am-5pm, Sundays 12pm-5pm
experiences.ag: All ages for most workshops; ornament and paperweight workshops best for 13 and up; pipe workshops 18+
experiences.sm: One-hour beginner workshops where you make your own wineglass, pendant or beads at the torch, or blow a pint glass, ornament or paperweight from the furnace; pieces cool overnight and are ready the next day or can be shipped.
experiences.q: Looking for a good time with friends or family while you are in St. Petersburg? Zen Glass Studio offers workshops for first-timers to try their hand and have a memorable experience.

experiences.ad: 1211 1st Ave. N., Suite 101, St. Petersburg, FL 33705
experiences.pr: $50 standard, $65 preferred, $90 VIP (including tax and fees)
experiences.ag: Family-friendly; not recommended for children age 3 and under
experiences.sm: A 70-minute stage show by illusionists Chris and Ryan Zubrick that mixes sleight of hand, family-friendly comedy and grand-scale illusions, at the Zubrick Magic Theatre in St. Petersburg.

morean-glass-studio.n: Morean Glass Studio and Hot Shop
